## Why Levitate?

Create Magic

It’s one of our core values, and a serious job perk. You’ll join a passionate team of people building something entirely new.

Flexible PTO

Flexible PTO to help you maintain work-life balance, with time available to new team members from day one.

Health & wellness

Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with additional wellness perks such as a Healthy Lifestyle Reimbursement Program or access to an onsite gym, depending on office location. Flexible Spending Accounts are also available to eligible employees.

Workplace flexibility

With offices in Raleigh, Tampa, and Toronto, we value in-person collaboration while offering opportunities for workplace flexibility based on role, location, and tenure.

Parental leave

Up to 12 weeks paid maternity and 4 weeks paid paternity leave to welcome and support the newest addition to the family.

401K

Both Traditional and Roth 401(k) options through Betterment LLC.

Community

With volunteer opportunities, small business pop-ups, and buying lunch (see ‘Free Lunch’) from locally owned businesses, we support the community wherever we can. We’re also a carbon neutral/certified “Green Place To Work.”

Culture

From Disc Golf and Run Club to epic parties, our Culture Crew is always creating opportunities to engage with other employees, teach you something new, or embrace the things that you’re passionate about.

Free lunch

They say there’s no such thing as a free lunch, but at Levitate that’s not true. 5 days a week, we provide a catered lunch. Besides being delicious, that’s a perk that, at $10/day, works out to another $50/week or ~$2,500/year! No more soggy sandwiches from home.

## Hear from our team

A real difference

“What I love most about Levitate is feeling like the work we do actually makes a difference for small business owners.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/katie-conley.jpg)

—Katie Conley, Senior Inbound Qualification Representative

Creative work

“I really enjoy my position at Levitate because I’m able to get to know our clients and turn their ideas into websites that tell their stories. The enthusiasm and creativity of my colleagues make every day enjoyable and inspire me to push the boundaries of what we can achieve together.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/logan-patterson.jpg)

—Logan Patterson, Senior Web Designer

Always something new

“The team here at Levitate is incredible. It’s great to work alongside such a creative and innovative group of people. New features are developed regularly, and I love being able to share those with my clients.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/macy-gill.jpg)

—Macy Gill, Principal Customer Success Specialist

Friendly faces

“I love Levitate because of the people I get to work with. Everyone is so friendly and helpful, which makes me feel happy to come into the office every day. I also love that Levitate caters lunch for us daily.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/jon-murphy.jpg)

—Jon Murphy, Operations Coordinator

Customers at the core

“The best part about Levitate is the people behind it. The core of what we do is centered on our customers; that empathy trickles down from leadership and is present in the way we do things here.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/sam-foulkes.jpg)

—Sam Foulkes, Senior Marketing Specialist

Room to grow

“Our staff is welcoming and supportive and appreciates people for what they bring to the table. I look forward to growing with a company that values employee individualism and has given me a solid foundation for a career path forward!”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/alex-kallimanis.jpg)

—Alex Kallimanis, Facilities Coordinator

Mutual respect

“Levitate’s positive and inclusive environment makes coming to work a joy. It’s truly refreshing to be part of a team that values collaboration, creativity, and mutual respect.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/cady-willard.jpg)

—Cady Willard, Senior Manager, Sales

Meaningful impact

“I’m inspired, every day, by our commitment to small and medium-sized businesses. We make an incredible impact helping entrepreneurs succeed and provide value to their customers and partners—I’m proud to be a part of this team.”

![](https://www.levitate.ai/careers/atif-mahmood.jpg)

—Atif Mahmood, Senior Director, Revenue Insights
